notes.title: Happy New Year from Nexodus Games!
notes.notes:
It has been just over a couple weeks since Civlands was officially announced on Steam, and so far I have been blown away with the interest! While though Nexodus Games is a team of one, I am super passionate and excited about my game and cannot wait to show you more this year as we lead up to the inevitable full release. 

Wishing you all happy holidays and a wonderful 2020.

Sincerely,
Andrew of Nexodus Games
